project.name: 90s R&B Ballad
project.notes:
90s R&B BALLAD  (Babyface, Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis, Boyz II Men era)

SOUND
Slow (60-75 BPM), soft drum machine kit, digital FM electric piano and Rhodes, fretless-style
bass, string pads, many stacked vocal harmonies, long plate reverb.

REFERENCE GEAR (sourced)
- The DX7 "E.PIANO 1" preset (factory 11) was on 61% of 1986 R&B #1s and 39% of Hot 100 #1s
  (Lavengood, via MusicRadar; Reverb Machine). This evidence covers 1984-88, not the 90s.
- The Korg M1's famous presets come from house records; the M1 or Rhodes as defining 90s
  ballad sounds: unconfirmed.

WORKFLOW
Play the DX E.Piano (Surge XT "DX EP" + TAL-Chorus-LX) as the main chords; Rhodes doubles or
answers. Record the lead, then stack harmonies on Stack Vocals (duplicate the track per part).
The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.

MIX NOTES
- Vocals are the record: a fast then a slow compressor, 3-5 dB each; Stack Vocals compressed
  together on the Vocal Bus.
- Plate: Space D "Plate", decay about 3 s, pre-delay 60 ms, high shelf down 2 dB.
- Drums soft: a fast-attack compressor takes the edge off.
- Master: built-in glue, TDR VOS SlickEQ "2buss Presence", Lemon Limiter; -11 to -9 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Medium. No DX7 ROM "E.PIANO 1" voice (Surge XT "DX EP" stands in); the drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
MusicRadar "Why the Yamaha DX7 was the most important release in synth history"; Reverb
Machine "Exploring the Yamaha DX7, Part Two"; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- TAL-Chorus-LX (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-chorus-lx
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TDR VOS SlickEQ (freeware (free edition, not GE)): https://www.tokyodawn.net/tdr-vos-slickeq/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 68 BPM, 4/4, key Dbmaj, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (LinnDrum) = kick-acoustic.wav, Snare (LinnDrum) = snare-acoustic.wav, Clap (LinnDrum) = clap.wav, Closed Hat (LinnDrum) = hat-acoustic.wav, Open Hat (LinnDrum) = openhat-acoustic.wav, Ride (LinnDrum) = ride.wav, Crash (LinnDrum) = crash.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -14, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 1)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (11 steps on), swing 54% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- DX E.Piano (Instrument, -6 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Keys/DX EP"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Chorus-LX: default settings
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -14 dB
- Rhodes (Instrument, -9 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/E. Piano 1"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
- Synth Bass (Instrument, -6 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Basses/Fretless Bass"
- Strings Pad (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Strings/Soft Strings"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -12 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -20 dB
- Stack Vocals (Audio, -8 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 4, Attack 5, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Predelay 60, Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 3, Decay Curve 1, Output EQ High -2, IR "Plate")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 441.2, Feedback 0.2, Tone 4500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Channel EQ (High 1); Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 1.8, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Tokyo Dawn Labs: TDR VOS SlickEQ: factory preset "2buss Presence"; Lemon Limiter: gain +2.5 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
